It mostly depends on how you play but I would recommend learning Industrial craft, its the first mod I learned back in the day. Start off making an electric furnace and a generator. Then you can work on a macerator to start doubling ores. Once you get the hang of that work on Immersive Engineering and get yourself some passive power with the waterwheels, that mod has an in game book to help you out. From there let me know how you like it.
